name: Accurate Block Placement Reborn 1.4.4+mc-1.21.9-1.21.11
changelog:
This release:

Officially backports v1.4.4 to 1.21.9-1.21.11, consisting of:
- Improves the fix for [Issue #28](https://github.com/KadTheHunter/AccurateBlockPlacement-Reborn/issues/28)

- _A previous fix to prevent accidentally opening containers whilst placing blocks was poorly implemented. Going forward it should be much harder to do so._
- Cleans up various parts of the code
- Updates Russian translations (thanks [@chtko](https://github.com/chtko) and [@AnarchByte](https://crowdin.com/profile/anarchbyte)!)
- Completes Portuguese (Brazilian) translations (thanks [@murilommelo](https://github.com/murilommelo)!)

- Fast Block Breaking

- Full translations for Portuguese (Brazilian), Russian, and Ukrainian

name: Accurate Block Placement Reborn 1.3.11+mc-1.21.9-1.21.11
changelog:
This update:

- Officially adds support for 1.21.11
- Switches from Yarn to Mojang Mappings in preparation for Deobfuscation / 26.1
- Updates the Russian translations thanks to [@chtko](https://github.com/chtko) in [#38](https://github.com/KadTheHunter/AccurateBlockPlacement-Reborn/pull/38)
- Fixes use state of items being reset when a new block was targeted
  - This primarily applies to Shields, at least in Vanilla. Thanks to [@adefffffffffffffff](https://github.com/adefffffffffffffff) for reporting this in [#43](https://github.com/KadTheHunter/AccurateBlockPlacement-Reborn/issues/43)!

name: Accurate Block Placement Reborn 1.3.10+mc-1.21.9
changelog:
This update adds support for 1.21.9, 1.21.10, & 1.21.11 and drops support for older versions within the same `.jar` file.

Going forward, older versions will be supported via separate releases/`.jar` files.

name: Accurate Block Placement Reborn 1.3.10-mc1.21.9-beta

This update adds support for 1.21.9, and (temporarily) drops support for prior versions.

This is a **BETA** release, so bugs may be present, and Mod Menu/Cloth Config compat is unknown and untested.

name: Accurate Block Placement Reborn 1.3.4
changelog:
This release fixes a couple of bugs:

- Plantable food items (Carrots, Potatoes, Sweet Berries) can now be planted accurately
- Placeable items in the off-hand slot will now place accurately even when a non-placeable item is in the main-hand slot

name: Accurate Block Placement Reborn 1.3.3-beta
changelog:
This release adds support for Minecraft 1.21.5

Due (at the time of writing) to Mod Menu only having a release candidate for 1.21.5, and Cloth Config having nothing, this is marked as a beta. 

Using Cloth Config for 1.21.4 with this release **will** result in a crash when attempting to access the config screen via Mod Menu.

This release may work when Mod Menu and Cloth Config update, or it may not; A stable release will be provided at that time.

name: Accurate Block Placement Reborn 1.3.2 for 1.21.2-1.21.4
changelog:
This release:

- Fixes the vanilla behavior of scaffolding being inaccessible when Accurate Block Placement is enabled ([#19](https://github.com/hschwar/AccurateBlockPlacement-Reborn/issues/19))
- Fixes Shulker Boxes vanilla behavior when right-click is held being inaccessible when Accurate Block Placement is enabled ([#28](https://github.com/hschwar/AccurateBlockPlacement-Reborn/issues/28))
  - This may be tweaked in future updates, as this fix has introduced an inconsistently replicated issue with unwanted opening of shulker boxes and other storage blocks when mass placing them.
- Adds two new options in the config

toggles whether a confirmation message will be sent when a feature is toggled on or off
  -

determines where the confirmation is sent (Chat or HUD)
- Improved the wording and colorization of the confirmation message
- Credited LordEnder-Kitty to the contributor list for their suggestion of and work on the confirmation options ([#27](https://github.com/hschwar/AccurateBlockPlacement-Reborn/issues/27))
